findings.finding: Vulcan Elements explicitly described its headquarters as being in North Carolina’s Research Triangle Park, supporting Durham/Research Triangle Park headquarters locality.

USAspending publishes 12 TW Alexander Dr, Bldg 200, Ste 100, Durham, NC 27709-0152 as Vulcan Elements Inc.’s recipient address for contract FA864925P0394; the record does not designate that street as headquarters.

Reuters reported on July 10, 2026 that Vulcan’s $620 million OSC loan remained on track while ReElement stopped pursuing its separate $80 million loan; exact Vulcan closing and disbursement remain unresolved.
